first_error.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The harness unopened-matter lists at [35] and [41] named the matter, and the agent's own summary at [26] listed it as a candidate; it never opened it.
first_error.why: Its file-name searches ([25]) named the needed matter as a candidate with tax-indemnity files, but when choosing what to read it opened a joint venture and two other matters and never opened it.

divergence: All three runs fail the same way and at the same kind of stage: their file-name searches or scans listed the needed matter with tax-indemnity files (T2's own summary named it), but each run chose later-dated candidates to read (a joint venture's tax protection agreement and an acquisition agreement) and never opened it, then named one of those as the most recent precedent. In T0 and T2 the harness lists of surfaced-but-unopened matters named the needed matter before the reading stage; in T1 the review flagged only that a single candidate had been examined. T0 switched its answer between the two later candidates after a review flagged blank signatures in both, writing the second answer inside a stage it had declared for verification. Reviewer-suggested recency cross-checks (T2) were not run.
